shots.typography: One clean geometric/grotesk sans throughout (low-confidence guess: Inter or Notion's own UI sans). Kinetic lines are bold, sentence case, normal tracking, set at headline size on white; product UI text is regular weight, sentence case, at real UI scale (most sidebar/table text is too small to read at sheet resolution). Status pills use small medium-weight labels on tinted rounded chips; zoomed-in card titles reach headline size. Customer names appear as their own logotypes.
shots.what_happens: A single continuous 67 s motion-graphics take with no detected cuts; scenes hand off through pushes, zooms and morphs (36 events per anchors). (1) A typed 'Notion is' trails a dotted line that morphs into black pills, then turns into stacked 'Notion is not an AI chatbot' / 'not a Task tracker' / 'not a Note taking app' lines. Each has a doodle avatar, and each product chip gets negated in turn: a blue chip arrow turns down, a green checkbox flips to a red X, and the note chip is struck through (w5-w24). (2) The layout slides off, leaving the Notion logo (w25-w31), which resolves into a 'Lumi Labs' workspace chip that expands into the full Lumi Labs Hub page; an AI chat panel slides in (w32-w43). (3) The camera pushes into the prompt box: 'Build a project tracker for offline mode' types on, the cursor clicks send, 'Thinking' with coloured dots appears and the mascot morphs into a building project table (w44-w56). (4) A task row opens into a side peek, the camera pushes to 'Start transcribing', a live meeting transcript streams in with three listener avatars, then 'Creating summary' resolves into a bulleted summary (w57-w68). (5) The summary lands in a 'Project Plan: Offline Mode' page, which scrolls to an Engineering tasks kanban. A zoomed card flips from 'Pull request: Open / On track' to 'Merged / Complete' on its own (w69-w82). (6) The 'How can I help you today?' search with app icons gets the question typed in; the send button is zoomed and clicked, and a '59 Results' answer streams in (w83-w92). (7) Three teammate questions stack up; '1 reply' chips append; Notion AI answers Catherine and a fire-emoji reaction counter ticks up (w93-w99). (8) A customer logo grid builds one logo at a time (w100-w107), then the ramp logo leads into a Product Roadmap timeline where 'Launch Ready' flips to 'Launched', and a team chat thread celebrates (w108-w115). (9) Everything clears to a black vertical caret that shrinks, and 'Not' starts typing just before the crossfade (w116).
shots.build_rebuild: On one white 1920x1080 canvas, build a GSAP master timeline of scene groups (kinetic negation lines, logo to workspace, prompt type-on, transcript stream, kanban status flip, search answer stream, chat replies, staggered logo grid, roadmap status flip). Chain them with camera scale/translate pushes on a shared wrapper rather than cuts, and keep a persistent SVG mascot face that redraws its expression at each scene change.
